title: Compliance Type is required free text with examples in an (i)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as an Owner/Admin or as a user with "Settings Service" enabled.
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings, open the "Maintenance" entry beneath "Inspection Templates" (if the build shows "Maintenance schedules" instead, use that entry and record the label). Schedules are shared by the whole organization, whichever location is chosen in the header.
  3. The Add service form open with "Is this a compliance inspection?" turned on (New schedule > Add service > turn it on).
custom_steps:
1. Read the Type field and hover (or tap) the (i) beside it.
  2. Type any free text, e.g. "Ontario Annual Safety Inspection".
  3. Clear Type, fill the other fields (Term 12 months) and try to save the service.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The (i) beside Type shows the examples Annual safety, Annual state, Annual federal, Emissions test.
  • Type accepts any free text you type.
  • The service cannot be saved with Type blank.
  • On the design the (i) reads "e.g. Annual safety, Annual state, Annual federal, Emissions test".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10560 (S3, Add a compliance inspection service), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S3 (Type; S3-R3); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboards K01, K02; read 6 Oct 2026.
